svg.title: Daily Cisco phone boot: daily profile service and bounded firmware maintenance
svg.desc: The phone loads firmware from flash, requests configuration from TFTP and establishes fresh SIP registration. The implemented daily profile-only service has no firmware volume and shares an exclusive lock with bounded firmware maintenance. One physical warm boot passed; cold boot and persistent deployment acceptance remain pending. One IP allowlist is not per-device or per-file authentication.
svg.text: A stored firmware image is only part of boot
Configuration availability and fresh registration must be checked separately.
Verify both lines after this boot
Old contacts and web access are not proof
Daily profiles at the fixed TFTP address; no Asterisk rollout
Exact inventory files → exact phone IPv4 sources → profile transfer → fresh registration
Read-only file allowlist · no firmware volume · one TFTP port owner
Warm pilot passed; cold boot, managed image and node startup still need acceptance.
One shared lock; drain before handover.
Keep default DROP rules. Migrate the closed baseline to the reviewed version-2 exact-source policy.
Source IP is not authentication. An allowed phone can request other profiles in a shared TFTP root.
